district_name: Mountain View Union Elementary School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(I) inventory: Mountain View Union Elementary School District, a union elementary district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (member towns: Greensboro, Hardwick, Stannard, Woodbury). Created by State Board order under Act 46 (operational July 1, 2019); operates PK-6. The board's post and all ten memberships were built 2026-10-27 from the district's annual reports (see the board's sources); the October 23, 2025 vacancy announcement had named one Greensboro seat and one Hardwick seat.
Mountain View Union Elementary School District (official site, via Orleans Southwest SU).

board.org_name: Mountain View Union Elementary School Board
board.post_note: ONE post, district-wide floor electorate: the seats are town-designated (Hardwick 5, Greensboro 2, Woodbury 2, Stannard 1) but every voter of the district votes on every seat at the February annual meeting.

sources.note: Mountain View Union Elementary School District Annual Report 2026 (official, Orleans Southwest SU): the pre-meeting board table (board as published January 2026) lists Samantha Friend (Chair) 2026, Terri Vest (Vice Chair) 2027, Darren Usinowicz (Clerk) 2026, Kyle Anderson 2028, Laura Cannon 2026, Simon Cohen 2026, Adam Gann 2026, Heather Meacham 2027, Meghan Shatney 2026, Juliana Swank 2026. The 2026 warning (Article 2) elects directors FROM THE FLOOR at the February 24, 2026 annual meeting: Greensboro 1x 3-year + 1x 1-year-remaining, Hardwick 2x 3-year + 1x 1-year-remaining, Stannard 1x 3-year, Woodbury 1x 3-year (seven seats). The same report's February 25, 2025 annual-meeting minutes record: Kyle Anderson (Hardwick, 3-year) ELECTED 49-7; Meghan Shatney (Hardwick, 1-year-remaining) ELECTED 30-16-12; Simon Cohen (Stannard, 1-year-remaining) ELECTED unanimously; Heather Meacham (Woodbury, 2-years-remaining) ELECTED 38-20. Mountain View UESD board (Orleans Southwest SU, official sources): ten town-designated seats -- Hardwick 5, Greensboro 2, Woodbury 2, Stannard 1 (apportionment derived from the district's 2024-2026 annual-report warnings and election minutes; no articles document was fetched). Directors are elected FROM THE FLOOR by the district-wide electorate at the February annual meeting (only the budget goes to Australian ballot), so the district is modeled as ONE 10-seat post with the allocation stated here. All ten current members were minted 2026-10-27 (the district was structure-only): four with directly published ends (Vest 2027, Anderson 2028, Meacham 2027, Usinowicz 2029), Cohen at 2029 by the seat arithmetic disclosed in his source note, and five ELECTED with ends held (Friend, Gann, Shatney, Cannon, Swank -- re-elected February 24, 2026 per the superintendent's 'everyone returned' letter, but which warned seat length each took is unpublished). Cannon's and Swank's towns are likewise unpublished (one holds a Greensboro seat, the other a Hardwick seat). The February 24, 2026 annual-meeting minutes (expected in the 2027 annual report) would close every held end.

Mountain View UESD Annual Report 2025 (official, OSSU): its February 27, 2024 annual-meeting minutes record Terri Vest (Hardwick, 3-year) ELECTED 45-39 -- term ending 2027 -- and Ana Peltz (Woodbury, 3-year) ELECTED 42-41, whose seat Heather Meacham was elected to fill for the remainder in 2025.

Mountain View UESD Annual Report 2024 (official, OSSU): its February 28, 2023 annual-meeting minutes record Samantha Friend (Greensboro, 3-year), Adam Gann (Hardwick, 3-year) and Darren Usinowicz (Woodbury, 3-year) each ELECTED unanimously -- the terms published as ending 2026 in the 2026 annual report's board table.

OSSU superintendent's April 2026 ParentSquare letter (official): introduces the post-meeting Mountain View board as Kyle Anderson, Laura Cannon, Simon Cohen, Samatha Friend (Chair) [sic], Adam Gann, Heather Meacham, Meghan Shatney, Juliana Swank, Darren Usinowicz, Terri Vest, and states 'everyone returned' -- the February 24, 2026 meeting therefore re-elected every member whose published term expired in 2026.
